caption: This drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of stylized floral and bird motifs on a beige background. Three curved, blue-green stems rise from the bottom of the drawing, with each stem branching out and adorned with various leaves, flowers, and buds. The left stem has three brown, oval-shaped seed pods and green leaves. The central and right stems display several pink-orange and cream-colored blooming flowers with green and yellow leaves, as well as sprays of small orange and yellow buds. Surrounding the flowers are four birds: two birds fly in the upper portion of the drawing, and two stand on the lower ground. All birds have blue bodies, yellow heads, brown wings, and feathery green and blue tails. Along the bottom edge of the drawing, there is a narrow band suggesting grass or vegetation, composed of vertical green strokes. The overall composition is delicate and balanced, utilizing a muted and pastel color palette with emphasis on green, blue, yellow, brown, and pink tones.
title: Set of Crewel Embroidered Bed Curtains
